Game Overview

Battle of Zombie Armies! Necromancers is a zombie game built around command your undead forces in thrilling, fast-paced 40-second battles. Master strategic summoning and unleash surprise boosters to outwit opponents. Whether facing off against a friend or an AI, adapt your necromancer's abilities for ever-evolving challenges and guide your relentless zombie troops to ultimate victory.
